sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-10,400 (levels 1-17). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Kudzu Connection T3. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Tesla Bullets. Ultimate (Air Drop) is available from Tesla Bullets.

items.name: Extended Magazine
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Tesla Bullets completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Tesla Bullets completes 4.8k weapon in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Titanic Magazine
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Tesla Bullets completes 3,200 souls on. Upgrade of Extended Magazine (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Tesla Bullets completes 4.8k weapon in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Tesla Bullets
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 46% weapon damage.

items.name: Monster Rounds
items.caption: Temporary, sold when you buy Ricochet later. Until then it speeds up camps: +25% weapon damage and +25% bullet resist against non-hero targets.

items.name: Intensifying Magazine
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 5,600 to 7,200 invested: bonus 46 to 54% weapon damage.

items.name: Headshot Booster
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 7,200 to 8,000 invested: bonus 54 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Active Reload
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: swap_candidate)

items.name: Extra Health
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 5600 souls (~5.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 10,400-29,600 (levels 17-30). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Stone Form T3, Air Drop T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Stone Form, damage) grows from 86.5 to 171. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Stamina Mastery.

items.name: Fortitude
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Stamina Mastery
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (3,200 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 20 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Headhunter
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 9,600 to 12,000 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Capacitor
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

items.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
items.why: spirit investment only and the build never reaches the 4.8k spirit tier through the core: timing review
items.legacy_note: Thorns put it on them, so drop Thorns before you shoot.

items.name: Siphon Bullets
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 12,800 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 29,600-48,800 (levels 30-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Entangling Thorns T3.

items.name: Silencer
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 15,200 to 21,600 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

items.name: Inhibitor
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Ricochet
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 21,600 to 27,200 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Capacitor? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Intensifying Magazine.
sections.desc: Dying after Capacitor? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Intensifying Magazine.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Their spirit damage keeps hurting you after the hit, like Infernus burn or Seven's ult.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult or stun you can see coming.
